updates.title: Gallery updates
updates.subtitle: These local galleries were re-uploaded on ExHentai with a new gid.
updates.empty: No galleries with updates were found.
updates.deleteConfirmBody: Delete {n} update record(s). Gallery files are not removed.
updates.archiveBody: Choose the archive quality. The old local copy is removed after the new download.

ignored.title: Ignored updates
ignored.subtitle: These updates no longer appear in the active list.

library.title: Duplicate copies
library.subtitle: One gallery (gid) exists in several scan roots. Choose the copy to keep.
library.confirmKeepBody: Make “{title}” the kept copy for this group?
library.confirmDeleteBody: Keep “{title}” and delete the other {n} on-disk copy(ies)? This cannot be undone.
library.emptyBody: Scan the library to list every gallery that exists in more than one scan root.

favorites.title: Favorite duplicates
favorites.subtitle: Different versions of one work (DL / uncensored / language re-uploads).
favorites.hint: Start a scan to compare all favorited galleries.
favorites.confirmUnfavBody: Remove the {n} selected item(s) from favorites?
favorites.confirmDeleteBody: Remove the {n} selected item(s) from favorites and delete local copies?
favorites.noFavorited: None of the selected items are favorited.
favorites.cloudFailed: Cloud removal failed; only the local record was removed

ignoredPage.title: Ignored favorite duplicates
ignoredPage.subtitle: Groups you marked as not duplicated. Select and restore them to include them again.
ignoredPage.emptyBody: Ignored groups stay out of duplicate results until you restore them.

favorites.emptyBody: Scan to list different versions of the same work and compare them one by one.

cross.title: Cross-GID duplicates
cross.subtitle: Different gids in the library (including cloud favorites) that look like the same work.
cross.hint: Not computed yet. Scan the library first or press Recompute.
cross.noFav: None of the selected items are favorited.
cross.infoDetail: Local galleries and uningested cloud favorites are clustered by normalized title, artist and core title. Unfavoriting only changes favorites; deleting downloads removes local copies.
cross.hintBody: Scan the library first, then press Recompute to cluster by title.
cross.noneBody: Recompute to list different gids that look like the same work.

recycle.title: Recycle bin
recycle.subtitle: User deletions and scan-expunged entries are managed separately.
recycle.emptyBody: Deleted galleries stay here for 30 days and can be restored at any time. Once expired or permanently deleted they cannot be recovered.
recycle.purgeBody: Permanently delete the database records of the {n} selected gallery(ies).

integrity.title: Missing pages
integrity.subtitle: Galleries whose page count does not match the files on disk.
integrity.emptyBody: The scan compares each gallery's recorded page count with the files on disk; galleries with missing pages appear here.
integrity.emptyBodySummary: Checked {scanned}/{total} galleries, {corrupt} corrupt; page counts and files match.
integrity.pauseHint: Scans do not start while the global pause is active.
integrity.infoDetail: The scan compares the recorded page count with the number of files on disk. Repair re-queues the selected galleries to fill in missing pages.
